content: I wonder if the VCs would fund an entirely fictitious implementation of Twitter with AI of course. All the others can be exactly the kind of people who make you feel good. On "Your Own Twitter," or perhaps  "TWTR 4 U" you'd have the most followers of anyone. Elon Musk would kiss your ass. You could change reality at will, have Trump removed from office and watch the MAGAs wail in pain. You could say absolutely whatever you like and never be cancelled. Don't laugh, I bet this happens.
